project_type: Monorepo (npm workspaces) monster-raising game 'AIモンスター育成'. packages/shared (@ddm/shared pure TS game logic), packages/backend (@ddm/backend AWS Lambda handlers), packages/frontend (@ddm/frontend React + Vite, JA/EN i18n), infra (CDK).
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` builds shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra via tsc/vite. Node v22.23.3 at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin (may need: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH").
test_framework: node:test with --experimental-strip-types (no external test deps, DOM/React kept out of test files).
test_command: npm test (shared, baseline 47) AND npm test -w @ddm/frontend (frontend ui-helpers/i18n suite, baseline 62)
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH for node. 2) npm run build must succeed (tsc typecheck across all workspaces + vite build). 3) npm test shows shared >=47 incl new validation tests. 4) npm test -w @ddm/frontend shows >=62. 5) Confirm createMonster('m','でじたん',T0) still validateMonster()->true (existing default name of 4 chars must pass).
setup_instructions: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; from repo root run `npm run build` once to confirm baseline green. Dependencies already installed (node_modules present).
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). No new runtime dependencies allowed. There is an unrelated 1-line uncommitted change to package-lock.json already in the working tree at session start; do NOT revert it and do NOT include it in feature commits (leave it alone / it belongs to orchestrator). Do not touch backup/previous-main branches.
contribution_requirements: i18n: packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts has JA_MESSAGES as source of truth; MessageKey is derived; EN_MESSAGES is typed Record<MessageKey,string> so EVERY new key MUST have BOTH ja and en entries or the build fails. Keep JA output byte-identical for existing keys. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for dialog animation. Mirror the accessible #20/#32 reset-confirm dialog pattern (role=alertdialog, aria-modal, focus input on open, Escape cancels, focus restore on close, simple focus trap).
key_patterns: Shared game logic is pure (no I/O, returns new objects). validateMonster is a pure predicate used server-side in saveMonster.ts before putMonster (DynamoDB) - tightening it enforces the cap on save. Frontend state owned by useMonster.ts hook: mount flow does api.getMonster; on 404 (null) it hatches via createMonster(id, DEFAULT_MONSTER_NAME='でじたん', now) and api.saveMonster. monster.name flows to StatsPanel header (h2), BattlePanel playerName, SpeechBubble, and chat (api.chat monsterName). Dialog state pattern lives in App.tsx (confirmingReset + focus refs + handleResetDialogKeyDown).
